stance_basis: direct quote stating no adverse long range effect on department facilities
summary: Peter B. Bensinger, as Director of the Illinois Department of Corrections, reviewed the draft environmental statement and found that the construction of the project would present no adverse long-range effect on the operation of facilities under his department's jurisdiction. His comment was purely informational and non-objecting, expressing neither support nor opposition to the project.
complaint_summary: The Department of Corrections, under Director Bensinger, stated that the construction of the project will present no adverse long-range effect on the operation of facilities under its jurisdiction.
summary_quote: the construction of this project will present no adverse long range effect on the operation of facilities under the jurisdiction of this department.
